event_summary: A cloudy liquid in a large metal pot continuously churns with surface bulges, edge foam, pale partially submerged clumps, and rising mist.
raw_event_description: The video begins with an open metal pot filled near the rim with cloudy pale liquid. The liquid surface is already moving, with rounded bulges and small bubbles appearing and collapsing near the center. White froth remains around parts of the perimeter. Pale irregular clumps intermittently rise into view, shift, and become obscured again by the cloudy liquid. A translucent white mist plume remains above the pot and drifts mostly behind and to the right of the rim throughout the clip. No clear beginning or end of the process is shown.

reasons: The pot, rim, cloudy liquid, foam, and mist are visible in the first frame.
The liquid surface is already active in the first frame.
Some contents below the surface are obscured by the cloudy liquid and mist.
